newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa quiet, directionless, drifts down.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa quiet, directionless, drifts down.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa fell in subdued trading ON Monday morning.
"There's nothing going on. It's just drifting down," one trader said.
"There's nothing to say about it. The market's totally dead," another said.
By the midday break active September was 10 stg lower 1,008 stg. September volume was 158 lots of a total 307.
The quiet was made worse by a fire alert which briefly disrupted business, traders said.
The exchange's Commodity Quay building had to be evacuated after an alarm which sounded at 0925 GMT, a LIFFE spokeswoman said. Contracts re-opened at 1005 GMT.
